# Svelte (TypeScript)

A Svelte web app using TypeScript and Robo.js.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://svelte.dev/" title="Svelte" description="Cybernetically enhanced web apps." />
  <Card href="/docs/web-apps" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template web-apps/svelte-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Svelte components
- TypeScript support
- Vite-powered development
- File-based API routes

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
